<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
	<description>A 8bit Multiplier implemented using a pipelined approach.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">A clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">An active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
		<input id="mul_en_in">An input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
		
		<input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">The input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
		<input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">The input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
		
		
		<output id="mul_en_out">An output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
		<output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
	end
	
	<parameter_description>
		<parameter id="IDLE" value="0">Defines the idle state for the multiplier.</parameter>
		<parameter id="MULTIPLY" value="1">Defines the multiply state for the multiplier.</parameter>
	end
		
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		reg [15:0] mul_out_reg;
		reg [2:0] counter;
		reg [7:0] mul_a_reg, mul_b_reg;
		reg [15:0] pp[0:7];
		reg [15:0] sum[0:6];
		
		wire [15:0] temp[0:7];
		
		integer i,j,k,l,m,n,o,p,q,r,s,t,u,v,w,x,y,z;
		
		
		always@(posedge clk) begin
			
			if(!rst_n)begin
				mul_en_out_reg <= 'd0;
			end else begin
				mul_en_out_reg[counter] <= mul_en_in;
			end
			
			
			counter = counter + 'd1;
			
		end
	
	
		assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[2];
		
		
		
		//storing inputs into registers
		always@(posedge clk) begin
			
			if(mul_en_out_reg[0])begin
				
				for(i = 0;i<8 ;i=i+1 )begin
					mul_a_reg[i] <= mul_a[i];	
				end
				
				
				for(j = 0;j<8 ;j=j+1 )begin
					mul_b_reg[j] <= mul_b[j];
				end
				
			end
			
		end
		
		
		
		
		//partial product generation
		genvar gen;
		generate
			for(gen=0;gen<8;gen=gen+1) begin
				assign temp[gen] = mul_b_reg[gen]?{8'd0 ,mul_a_reg[7-gen]}:'d0;
			end
		endgenerate
		
		
		
		//partial sum calculation
		always@(posedge clk) begin
			if(counter==1 && mul_en_out_reg[0])begin
				sum[0]<=temp[0]+temp[1];
				sum[1]<=temp[2]+temp[3];
				sum[2]<=temp[4]+temp[5];
				sum[3]<=temp[6]+temp[7];
				sum[4]<=sum[0]+sum[1];
				sum[5]<=sum[2]+sum[3];
				sum[6]<=(sum[4]+sum[5]);
				
			end
			
		end
		
	
		
		always@(posedge clk) begin
			if(mul_en_out_reg[2])begin
